# Particula

> A Python aerosol particle simulator with documentation, executable examples,
> and assistant skills for scientific studies and library development.

These links follow upstream `main` and describe development documentation,
not necessarily the latest published release. Check the installed Particula
version before applying APIs or examples. For a fixed version, use documentation
from the matching release tag or commit; do not assume development APIs exist
in an older installation.

Raw Markdown and Python links point directly to maintained repository files.
Resolve relative links against the containing file's repository directory at
the same revision. Python examples may require dependencies, helper files or
CUDA; consult their prerequisites before execution. Published example pages
include saved outputs that are not embedded in the Python sources.

## Documentation and studies

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/getting-started/installation/index.md): Choose an installation method.
- [First simulation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/getting-started/first-simulation.md): Build and run a small simulation.
- [Data model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/data-model/index.md): Native state, species and population semantics.
- [Processes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/processes/index.md): Supported physical processes.
- [GPU support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/gpu/support.md): Supported devices, operations and limitations.
- [Migration to 0.3.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/migration/v0.3.0/index.md): Changes from older APIs.
- [All runnable Python scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/studies/scripts.md): Find study sources across topics and devices.
- [Native aerosol example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/studies/tutorials/building-an-aerosol/native_aerosol.py): Executable Python source.
- [Particle data example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/studies/tutorials/building-an-aerosol/particles/particle_data.py): Executable Python source for particle state.
- [Agent plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/docs/guide/agent-plugins/index.md): Install and use Particula Helper.
- [Particula Helper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/plugins/particula-helper/README.md): Scientific workflows and repository skills.
- [Source discovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uncscode/particula/main/plugins/particula-helper/references/sources.md): Find documentation matching the selected environment.
- [API reference](https://uncscode.github.io/particula/API/particula/llms.txt): Generated Markdown index linking to module references.
